description: Show the current MisarDev plan, how much of each quota (builds, edits, projects) is left this period, and the link to compare plans and upgrade. Call it any time — not only after hitting a limit. Reads only: it never changes the plan or takes payment. On a local install, open=true also opens the pricing page in the user's browser.

open.description: Local installs only: also open the pricing page in the browser. The hosted server returns the link instead.

name: upgrade
